translations.web: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.
translations.bsb: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.
translations.kjv: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
translations.asv: For he hath looked upon the low estate of his handmaid: For behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
